# RatingList

The one “section header + meter + list of rows” block.

`NomNom.RatingList` · Ratings

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.RatingList />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.RatingList"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The one "section header + meter + list of rows" block. Pass `raters` for the meal shape, or `rows` + `bar` for any other distribution (SegmentedBar's breakdown uses the latter).

## Props (RatingListProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | @default 'Who rated' |
| `trailing` | `unknown` | Right-hand figure in the header. Defaults to "{rated} of {total}" when `total` is given. |
| `raters` | `{ name: string; role?: string; score?: number \| null; vsUsual?: number \| 'new' }[]` | score null = not rated yet; vsUsual: signed change, 0 = as usual, 'new' = first rating. |
| `rows` | `RatingListRow[]` | The general shape. Takes precedence over `raters`. |
| `rated` | `number` |  |
| `total` | `number` |  |
| `bar` | `unknown` | Replaces the default ProgressBar above the card — SegmentedBar passes its own track here. |

### RatingListRow

One row of a RatingList: a label, an optional note, a trailing value.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `unknown` |  |
| `note` | `unknown` |  |
| `value` | `unknown` |  |
